intro.text: E&P Systems, based in Sofia, Bulgaria, is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. dataCollect.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollect.text: We collect the following types of personal data:

items.0: Contact information (name, email address, phone number) submitted through our contact form
items.1: Analytics data collected through cookies (browsing behavior, pages visited, device information)
items.2: Technical data (IP address, browser type, operating system) for website functionality

items.0: Responding to your inquiries and providing requested information about our services
items.1: Improving our website experience and services based on analytics data
items.2: Communicating with you about projects and services you have expressed interest in

cookies.title: 4. Cookies Policy
cookies.text: Our website uses the following types of cookies:

items.0: Essential cookies: Required for basic website functionality (e.g., cookie consent preferences)
items.1: Analytics cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website to improve the user experience

cookies.optOut: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time using the cookie consent banner. You can also disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect website functionality.

items.0: Contact form inquiries are retained for up to 2 years, then securely deleted
items.1: Analytics data is aggregated and anonymized, and does not contain personally identifiable information

gdpr.title: 6. Your Rights Under GDPR

items.0: Right of access: Request a copy of your personal data we hold
items.1: Right to rectification: Request correction of inaccurate personal data
items.2: Right to erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
items.3: Right to data portability: Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format
